key.name: panel-position
key.description: Where the LyricBar indicator should be placed in the GNOME top bar.

key.name: max-width
key.description: Maximum width in pixels for the top-bar lyric label.

key.name: text-align
key.description: Horizontal alignment of the lyric text within the indicator ('left', 'center', or 'right').

key.name: fallback-mode
key.description: Display behavior when synced lyrics are unavailable.

key.name: player-priority
key.description: Preferred MPRIS player bus-name fragments, in priority order.

key.name: browser-player-service
key.description: How browser MPRIS players should be interpreted ('auto', 'spotify', 'youtube-music', 'apple-music', or 'generic').

key.name: cache-enabled
key.description: Whether lyric lookup results should be cached locally.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Whether verbose diagnostic logging should be enabled.
